name: Cannalicious RSO Dart | Rest
description: A broad spectrum full plant RSO product chalked full of rest inducing cannabinoids as well as a heavy indica terpene profile to promote a deep and lasting sleep. THC, CBD, and CBN are all present in this new RSO product designed to help you fall and stay asleep. The added terpenes give this product a delightful berry flavor profile that makes ingesting REST RSO that much more pleasant.
